note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text. The Mass of St Mark reprints this Gospel on pp. 511–512 of the same Benziger edition. The shared text follows the St Luke printing on p. 705. St Mark's reprint has the same words and four accidental differences: lower-case dóminum and no comma after messis (Rogáte ergo dóminum messis ut mittat), no comma after ecce (Ite: ecce ego mitto) and none after manéte (manéte edéntes), where p. 705 and the selected text have Dóminum messis, ut, ecce, ego and manéte, edéntes.
